text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from an outing, 
Loves Only You asked me a question.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Did you keep your schedule 
open after this, just as promised?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I don't have any particular plans
Yeah. I don't have any particular plans.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan. Did you keep your schedule 
open for me afterwards, just like you 
promised?"
choice_data_list: Yeah. I don't have any particular plans
Yeah. I don't have any particular plans.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~♡ Well then, keep me company for 
just a little longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Loves-san. Thank you for 
participating.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, you see... It's picking up 
trash on the beach!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Volunteering to do this all on your own... 
You really are so kind, Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
After all, Bouquet-chan's activities are 
just so full of "love"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, of course you'd want to help 
out, right?
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'll help out too!
If that's the case, I'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. The trash bag is full already! 
Proof of our hard work together, 
Trainer-kun♡
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could help. But...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. The trash bag is full already! 
Proof of our hard work together, 
Trainer-chan♡
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could help. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We weren't able to clean the entire beach. 
In terms of progress, we're only at about 
30%.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, we were able to clean up this 
entire area. We can continue the rest 
another time—how about that?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Be sure to call on us again when that 
time comes ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Or... let's see. Next is—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, I went and cleaned up the Earth~♡ 
How's that? Aren't I praiseworthy?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You're amazing" "Historic feat" 
"Following you for life"... Fufu. Oh, you 
guys are praising me too much~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 'We want to help too.' 'Is there 
anything we can do?' ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, you know—I already know very 
well how kind all the community members 
are.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was secretly hoping you'd say that to me 
♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's coordinate a day we can all 
meet up! —The "Trash Cleanup Event" is 
officially happening!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She then announced the event on a 
livestream restricted to verified 
members... and the result was,

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan! We're pretty much done over 
here! Hot-Blooded Sensei says he's almost 
done too!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really!? It's only been two hours since we 
started!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
Almost done over here too! I'm so glad I 
built up muscle for moments like this! 
This is total child's play!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♡ Well then, how about our 
middle-aged workout buddy gives us one 
more block of effort?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
Wait, one more plot!? ...A-Alright! Keep 
it up, my latissimus dorsi!

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard on the muscle 
training. I took plenty of paid leave, so 
I'll work twice as hard here for you!
choice_data_list: Haha. We can't afford to lose either!
Ahaha! We can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu♡ Yes, that's right."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "trash pickup event" organized 
by Loves Only You proceeded in a calm and 
peaceful atmosphere from start to finish—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyone! Thanks to all 
of you, the beach cleanup is finished!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always there to lend me a hand. 
I truly love that about you all."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again on stream, okay? ♡ —Love 
me ♡ Love you ♡ Thank you for watching! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Warm applause breaks out from all around. 
Swept up in the moment, I found myself 
clapping loudly too—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to Loves-san... we were able to 
restore the beautiful sandy beach I wanted 
to see."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just thanks to me, Bouquet-chan. 
—It was thanks to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You, Trainer, all the community members 
who participatedâand of course, me too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You, Trainer, all the community members 
who participatedâand of course, me too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's because we all did our best together. 
I'm glad we managed to pull it off♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Calling it popularity with people 
makes it sound way too grand.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the amazing one. It's everyone who 
supports me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! So, yeah. What I have is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maybe having the talent to be blessed with 
great people around me? ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Re~ally, you saved me! Thanks as always, 
Trainer-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Re~ally, you saved me! Thanks as always, 
Trainer-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Would you like to get 
tea together sometime soon?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let me reward you properly for all your 
hard work. Okay?

text_block_list.text:

okay?
